patch_list: Block Ads & Video Commercials - Angry Birds (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Eliminates full-screen video ads between levels, pause screen promos, and banner overlays in Angry Birds.
Free Shopping & Billing Bypass - Angry Birds (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Hooks Google Play Billing SDK in Angry Birds to bypass in-app purchase verification, unlocking free shopping for Mighty Eagle, power-up bundles, and episode packs.
Unlimited Mighty Eagle & Power-ups - Angry Birds Classic (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Unlocks the Mighty Eagle permanently with zero cooldown timer, and provides unlimited power-ups (Sling Scope, King Sling, Super Seeds, Birdquake).
Unlock All Episodes & Golden Eggs - Angry Birds Classic (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Unlocks all legendary episodes, level packs, and Golden Egg secret stages in Angry Birds Classic.
